title: Today’s menu card
brief: The card next to the headline is the first thing a customer reads: what’s ready, when, how much, and what’s gone. Three directions, all with the bakery’s own colors and fonts, none adding a fact that isn’t already on the page.

variants.name: Receipt
variants.note: A printed ticket from the counter: monospace, dotted leaders to the price, a torn edge. Feels made today.
variants.css: #menu{background:#FFFDF8;border:0;border-radius:6px 6px 0 0;padding:26px 26px 30px;font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Consolas,monospace;position:relative;box-shadow:0 26px 50px -30px rgb(47 74 58/.5)}#menu:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-9px;height:10px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 7px 0,transparent 6px,#FFFDF8 6.5px) 0 0/14px 10px repeat-x}#menu h2{font:700 13px/1 ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#2F4A3A;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1.5px dashed #C9BFAE}#menu h2 small{font:inherit;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#C8643B}#menu ul{margin-top:8px}#menu li{border-top:0;padding:9px 0;align-items:baseline;gap:6px}#menu li span:first-child{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}#menu li b{font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:#1F2A23;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:baseline}#menu li b:after{content:'';flex:1;border-bottom:1.5px dotted #C9BFAE;transform:translateY(-3px)}#menu li i{font-size:11.5px;color:#7d8478}#menu li span:last-child{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#2F4A3A}#menu .out b{color:#a7a99f}#menu .out span:last-child{color:#a7a99f;text-decoration:line-through}

variants.name: Chalkboard
variants.note: The board behind the counter, in the brand’s sage: big serif names, prices in terracotta, the time as a small chip. Strong next to the cream page.
variants.css: #menu{background:#2F4A3A;border:0;color:#F6F0E6;border-radius:24px;padding:28px 28px 20px;box-shadow:0 34px 70px -30px rgb(31 42 35/.7)}#menu h2{font:600 28px/1.1 Fraunces,Georgia,serif;color:#F6F0E6}#menu h2 small{font:600 11.5px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#F2B79C}#menu ul{margin-top:12px}#menu li{border-top:1px solid rgb(246 240 230/.14);padding:14px 0;align-items:center}#menu li b{font:600 19px/1.2 Fraunces,Georgia,serif;color:#F6F0E6}#menu li i{display:inline-block;margin-top:7px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:#DDE5DC;background:rgb(246 240 230/.1);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 9px}#menu li span:last-child{font:600 21px Fraunces,Georgia,serif;color:#F2B79C}#menu .out b{color:rgb(246 240 230/.45);text-decoration:line-through}#menu .out i{color:#F2B79C;background:rgb(242 183 156/.14)}#menu .out span:last-child{color:rgb(246 240 230/.4)}

variants.name: Tiles
variants.note: One tile per item, the ready time on top, and a last tile for the cakes the page already sells. Scans fastest on a phone and makes “sold out” obvious, at the cost of the list’s calm.
